people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: But of the multitude, many believed in him. They said, “When the Christ comes, he won’t do more signs than those which this man has done, will he?”
translations.bsb: Many in the crowd, however, believed in Him and said, “When the Christ comes, will He perform more signs than this man?”
translations.kjv: And many of the people believed on him, and said, When Christ cometh, will he do more miracles than these which this man hath done?
translations.asv: But of the multitude many believed on him; and they said, When the Christ shall come, will he do more signs than those which this man hath done?
